claims.text: The driver never entered the pickup geofence. For a STANDARD pickup POL-NS-02 sets the arrival radius at 50 m and requires at least three consecutive qualifying fixes inside it. The derived arrival facts record qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s across all 73 driver fixes over the full 12:26:15 to 12:38:35 trace. With no in-radius fix anywhere in the trace, POL-NS-02 provides that the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's own trace contradicts his statement that he 'was right at the pin'. His closest recorded position for the entire trip was 53.08 m from the pickup pin (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), which is outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. Because 53.08 m is the minimum over the whole trace, the driver was at least that far away at the moment he tapped 'I'm Here' at 12:31:25. The conclusion does not depend on the 25 m accuracy filter: no fix of any reported accuracy falls inside the radius.

POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold, and this fee fails on two of them. Limb (b) requires the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event; limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, which trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec fixes at 180 seconds. The trace shows 0 in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s, so both (b) and (c) fail and nothing is chargeable under this clause.

On the dwell arithmetic the shortfall is total. The required minimum is 180 seconds and the measured effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 180 seconds (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.shortfall_sec). POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full on any such shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied. The limb (i) accumulation route cannot rescue the fee: it requires a present and populated traffic_advisory, and EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING - I disclose the impairment, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so limb (i) is unavailable; in any event run_count is 0, so there are no separate in-geofence intervals to sum. EV-FARE-02720 shows SGD 4.50 charged with no refund issued, so a full refund returns SGD 4.50 to the rider.

If the driver's case is instead that he waited nearby, it still refunds the fee. His closest position, 53.08 m, is outside the arrival radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling that POL-NS-03 makes the whole test, and POL-NS-05's own rule routes a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03 rather than treating the marker as a false-arrival event. On that footing the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-03 refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full. registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill under POL-NS-03(ii) arises either.

The platform's own arrival event cannot carry the driver's case. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON and the event reads 'Driver tapped I'm Here', so this is a driver-pressed marker, not the GPS_AUTO arrival that POL-NS-12 treats as a carrier independent of the exported trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c). Arrival therefore stands or falls on the trace, and the trace shows no in-radius fix. The record also contains no wait_timer_expired event, so the platform never confirmed the waiting period as served.

The rider was at the pickup point the whole time, and her own device track proves it. It carries 66 fixes, all 66 of them qualifying, never more than 20.7 m from the pin and averaging 17.3 m (derived.rider_presence) - well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius that POL-NS-04 limb (c) uses. I do not rest the refund on POL-NS-04, because limb (a) is not made out: the rider's only message was 'ok', which is not a locating or coordinating message. The presence evidence is relied on to rebut the driver's no-show assertion; the refund itself follows from the driver's failure under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06.

This case is decidable and should produce a monetary ruling, not a referral. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the trace has 100 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence and no gap at all, the chat log's 2 messages reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, and the 4.50 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so limb (d) is satisfied. Neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) fires: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0. Nothing displaces the refund into human review.

No driver compensation is payable on this record. POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limbs (b) and (c) fail here, so the 80 percent payout has no trigger. The anti-farming check is not the reason the payout fails - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4 - the reason is simply that the fee was never chargeable, and a fee that is refunded in full funds no compensation.

claims.text: The platform's own trip telemetry records a driver_arrived event at 12:31:25, a wait_timer_started event at 12:31:27, and a termination by the driver at 12:37:28 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the record, and the fee's fate turns on limb (b) alone.

The rider's own device track places her at the pickup point throughout the window: 66 fixes from 12:29:27 to 12:39:14, every one at 0.0 km/h, each between 14.62 m and 20.74 m of the pin (mean 17.25 m) — far inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius — and she is still there nearly two minutes after the driver cancelled. The rider was at the pin and never came to the vehicle; this is rider non-appearance, not a rider who could not be found.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider on this record. The chat log holds exactly two messages: the driver's 'here' at 12:31:45 (read by the rider at 12:32:15) and the rider's 'ok' at 12:32:55. 'ok' states no position, entrance, block, tower or bay, asks the driver nothing and reports nothing, so it is not a locating or coordinating message and limb (a) of POL-NS-04 is not satisfied; that clause never engages, and the rider cannot be exonerated through it.

The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the driver did not cancel until 12:37:28 — 361 seconds after the wait timer started at 12:31:27. He gave the rider twice the period the fee buys, so this is not a driver who cancelled early or abandoned the pickup.

The driver's trace is complete — 73 fixes at the 10 s cadence, 100.0 % coverage, gaps empty and max_gap_sec 0.0 — and at its closest it places him 53.08 m from the pickup pin: 3.08 m outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and far inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling. The whole of limb (b) therefore turns on a 3.08 m positional margin, while POL-NS-02's own filter tolerates 25 m of horizontal uncertainty on every fix; the record describes a driver who drove to the pickup and stopped a few metres the wrong side of a 50 m circle, not one who never came.

If the Judge holds limb (b) failed on that margin, POL-NS-03 is the clause that governs, and neither of its fault limbs attaches to this driver: the rider never named an entrance, block, tower or bay in the chat log, so limb (i) is unmet, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so limb (ii) is unmet. Nothing in POL-NS-03 attributes the mislocation to this driver, and no driver-education item follows from it.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is nowhere near tripping, so no compensation is withheld and no POL-NS-09 escalation is forced on the driver's side: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 134 is 0.0075 against a threshold of 0.08. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against either party.

ruling.explanation: Both parties: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 12:31:25, started the wait timer at 12:31:27 and cancelled at 12:37:28 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event. But a no-show fee needs all four conditions of POL-NS-01, and two fail. The pickup is a STANDARD zone, so POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m and requires at least three consecutive qualifying fixes inside it. Across the driver's complete 73-fix trace (100% coverage, 10 s cadence, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s) his closest recorded position to the pin was 53.08 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m) — outside the 50 m radius — and the derived arrival facts return 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s. Limb (b) therefore fails, and limb (c) fails with it, because the required 180 s dwell (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) must be served inside the geofence and none was. The driver's argument that a 3.08 m margin should be excused by the 25 m accuracy filter is rejected: the filter is applied fix by fix within the policy's own test, and on that test no fix qualifies, so the record describes a driver who stopped a few metres short of the pickup point, not one who arrived. His further point that he waited 361 s from the tap does not help, because limb (c) measures continuous in-geofence dwell, not time elapsed since the button press. Likewise his assertion that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own instrument, and the rider's device track (66 qualifying fixes, all stationary, 14.62–20.74 m from the pin, still there after the cancellation) shows the rider was present, so she did not simply fail to appear. Because the driver's stationary position lay outside the radius but well inside 400 m (53.08 m), the fee is decided under POL-NS-03: the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded in full. On fault allocation, POL-NS-03(i) does not apply because the rider never named an entrance, block, tower or bay — her only message was 'ok' — and POL-NS-03(ii) does not apply because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. No pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable, and no driver compensation arises: POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. POL-NS-04 does not independently exonerate the rider because 'ok' is not a locating or coordinating message, but the refund does not depend on it. POL-NS-12 does not assist the driver because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. No escalation applies: the trace is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) (no gaps, full coverage, and the 4.50 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd so limb (d) is satisfied), the chat log reconciles with trip_record.chat_message_count of 2, neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) fires, and confidence (0.90) is above the 0.70 floor. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it is not relied on — POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable, and with run_count 0 there are no separate in-geofence intervals to accumulate in any event, so the missing advisory does not affect this outcome. The rider is refunded SGD 4.50, being the cancellation fee shown on the fare breakdown (total charged 4.50, refund issued 0.00); the monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: this dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02720, which the driver cancelled at 12:37:28 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW after tapping 'I'm Here' at 12:31:25. The fee does not stand and is refunded to the rider in full (SGD 4.50).

WHY. POL-NS-01 allows the fee only if all four limbs hold. Limb (a) holds (there is a driver 'arrived' event). Limb (b) does not. The pickup is a STANDARD zone, so POL-NS-02 sets the arrival radius at 50 m and requires at least three consecutive qualifying fixes inside it. Across the driver's full 73-fix track (12:26:15-12:38:35, 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, max gap 0.0 s) the closest fix is 53.08 m from the pin (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m) and the count of qualifying in-radius fixes is 0 (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count), with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. The driver's statement that he 'was right at the pin' is not supported: the trace never places him inside the geofence. His argument that a 3.08 m overage is immaterial because POL-NS-02 tolerates 25 m of accuracy is rejected - the 25 m filter decides which fixes are counted, it does not widen the radius - but it does place him inside POL-NS-03's 400 m band. Limb (c) also fails: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.shortfall_sec).

CONSEQUENCES. With no qualifying in-radius fix, POL-NS-02 provides that the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund; and because his stationary position lies outside the 50 m radius but within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-03 governs - the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-03 gives the driver no compensation here: the rider named no entrance, block or bay in the chat, so limb (i) does not apply, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill of limb (ii) does not arise. Independently, POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on the dwell shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied. The rider's claim that POL-NS-12 cannot carry the driver's case is accepted: arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, and there is no wait_timer_expired event. Her claim that the rider was at the pin is accepted as rebuttal (66 qualifying fixes, all within 20.7 m of the pin, still there after the cancellation), but the refund rests on the driver's failure under POL-NS-01/02/03/06, not on POL-NS-04, whose limb (a) is not made out. The driver's point that no POL-NS-03 fault limb attaches is correct and changes nothing: POL-NS-03 still refunds the fee in full and pays him nothing.

DRIVER COMPENSATION: NONE. POL-NS-07 pays 80% only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. The anti-farming check is not the reason (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1/134 = 0.0075 against 0.08); the payout simply has no trigger. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) escalates, and no artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d) (clock skew 0 s, no trace gap, chat reconciles at 2/2, and the 4.50 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd).

IMPAIRED ARTIFACT NAMED. EV-ADVIS-02720-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. It does not carry any deciding fact; it only makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route unavailable, and run_count is 0 in any event. The deciding fact is carried by the GPS trace and the trip record, each at weight 1.0, which is the confidence cap.

AMOUNTS. EV-FARE-02720 shows total_charged SGD 4.50, cancellation_fee SGD 4.50 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd SGD 4.50. Refund to the rider SGD 4.50; driver compensation nil. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05.

REFERRALS: NONE. No clause on these facts produces one. POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire - there is no evidence the arrival marker was false (>300 m or at/above 15 km/h) - and the driver used a valid limb (d) reason code, so no driver-education item arises. Confidence 0.90: the deciding fact is carried by full-weight artifacts, and the small 3.08 m margin is why the finding routes through POL-NS-03 and why confidence is not set higher.
